section_1_split_reconciliation.interpretation: The mart, Stage 3 predictions, Stage 5 predictions, and Train_Dev case-ID artifact agree on WEEK_NUM splits. Current artifacts do not contain a 35-row membership difference to enumerate. The 1,292,315/82,637 pair is therefore not reproduced; retain 1,292,350/82,602 as canonical for the saved week-based artifacts.

late_window_label_maturity.conclusion: Recorded target labels are 100% observed in all saved splits; there is no missing-label evidence for W86-W91 censoring. These artifacts lack a separate label-maturity/observation-window timestamp, so full outcome maturity cannot be certified. Reported late PD/bad-rate gaps are empirical divergence against recorded labels.

model_neutral_benchmark.equation: Realized Contribution = (APR_benchmark - Funding Cost - Opex) / 12 × Principal × amortizing balance factor - Principal × target × LGD; APR_benchmark=15%, COF=4%, Opex=1.5%, LGD=75%.

kgb_sensitivity.assumption: k multiplies OOT_Monitor target-based loss on Challenger-only (Swap-In) rows; this is a sensitivity on potentially unobserved outcomes, not evidence that these saved labels are missing.

scenario_based_expected_contribution.equation: Stage 6 profit = max((APR_tier-COF-Opex),0)/12 × principal × amortizing balance factor - principal × PD × LGD; base COF=4%, Opex=1.5%, LGD=75%.

definitions.false_rejection_good: good declined / all good in age × model-tier cell
definitions.false_approval_bad: bad approved / all bad in age × model-tier cell
definitions.AIR: age-band approval rate / maximum age-band approval rate for the same model

canonical_champion_and_m4_full.validation_status: Strict blind OOT_Monitor evaluation; Monitor excluded from fitting and model/cutoff selection.

M4-NoDrift.feature_exclusion_basis: SEVERE_CSI_FEATURES selected using Train_Dev vs OOT_Monitor CSI.
M4-NoDrift.promotion_requirement: Independent validation on a subsequent mature time window or Shadow Mode.
